title: 7 Months of Work — Try the Unstable Nuclear Reactor Demo!
author: UnityNinja
selftext:
Hello everyone!

For the past 7 months, I’ve been working on this project completely solo. During development, I’ve also had over 10,000 players try the game across different WebGL platforms, which helped me learn a lot and improve the core gameplay.

# ABOUT THE GAME?

Unstable Nuclear Reactor is an incremental hex-puzzle roguelite where you merge atoms into higher elements, create massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and carefully manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.

# WISHLIST & PLAY THE DEMO

I’d really appreciate any kind of feedback! I’m preparing to enter Steam Next Fest with 600+ wishlists, so this is a great time for me to find anything that feels confusing, frustrating, unbalanced, or simply not fun.

**If you have a few minutes, please give the demo a try and let me know what you think. I’m especially interested in honest feedback, even if you don’t like something!**

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692090/Unstable\\\_Nuclear\\\_Reactor\\\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692090/Unstable_Nuclear_Reactor_Demo/)
